tonight.headline: Down 31.5 before a snap, and nothing moved overnight: Jefferson's call may run to Sunday morning
body: Bad news first, and it is the same bad news as Friday. Kyle Monangai is out, in a walking boot, and his coach will only say 'we'll see how long that injury sidelines him'. Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are both questionable; the Saturday decision their coach promised had not been published by 09:30 Eastern, and one report now has it being made on Sunday morning. You are 0–4 and 31.5 behind on Bucky Irving's Thursday night; ESPN has you at 45%, 122.1 against 130.8.

Nothing needs doing today. A hundred searches this morning found no status change for any of your fourteen: Likely is cleared, McLaurin is questionable after one limited practice, Diggs is out. Tomorrow's brief is written at 07:00, before the 09:30 inactive lists, so the two cards below are the plan: read McLaurin, Jefferson and Addison off those lists yourself.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Irving's 31.5 is banked (archive). Ja'Marr Chase, 21.8, is still on their bench, questionable and not yet cleared from the concussion protocol in anything published by Saturday morning; Kendre Miller, 7.9, is in their flex. If Chase is cleared today and they put him back, their 130.8 rises by about fourteen. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.1.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.5, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Gordon 10.9, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. None has played. Jefferson is the one questionable starter.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Today: Chase's clearance on their side, and whether Minnesota elevate Odell Beckham Jr., which hints at doubt but proves nothing. Sunday 09:30: the inactive lists.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · fire it at the inactive list, Sun 09:30 Mexico City · both kick off Sun 11:00
doFirst.title: Sunday 09:30: McLaurin into the flex if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: Questionable after one limited practice on Friday, his first since 2 Oct; nothing changed overnight. 12.8 against Gordon's 10.9: a coin flip, and coin flips go to the projection. Wait for the inactive list.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 122.1; the projection lineup is 124.0. The whole 1.9 is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, and the tool labels it COIN FLIP. Both numbers are the same in this morning's snapshot as on Friday afternoon. The rule for a coin flip is to take the projection and write nothing more.

case.label: What the reports say
case.body: He practised on Friday, limited, after sitting out Wednesday and Thursday. Dan Quinn: 'Terry, I thought, looked really good today' (SI's final-report story, 9 Oct 21:46 UTC), with the decision closer to game time. Stefon Diggs is ruled out and Jayden Daniels starts. Nothing newer exists: no downgrade, no elevation, no insider note by 09:30 Eastern on Saturday. Rain showers are likely at Landover.

case.label: Why it waits for Sunday
case.body: One limited practice in eight days on a hamstring, and a coach who says the decision comes close to kickoff. McLaurin and Gordon both play at 11:00, so nothing is lost by making the swap at 09:30, and a swap made today is one you must remember to undo. Sunday's brief is written before the list, so this one is yours to fire.

case.label: If he is inactive
case.body: Gordon, 10.9, keeps the slot. The tool's own fallback is Kamara, 11.2, a 0.3 coin flip with Gordon, and Kamara is himself questionable with a back.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin starts in your flex and Gordon outscores him on Sunday (archive). No thesis rides on it either way: it is a coin flip.

action.label: If active Sunday: start McLaurin · bench Gordon

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · no decision published yet · inactives Sun 09:30 Mexico City · kickoff 11:00
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is inactive: Addison, then McLaurin
doFirst.subtitle: Both Vikings receivers are still questionable and the call may not come until Sunday morning. Do nothing now; the order is set here so Sunday is a checklist.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Jefferson was limited all three days and is questionable (vikings.com, 9 Oct 13:00). He says playing is 'definitely something that I want to do' and Kevin O'Connell says he 'progressed throughout the week' (TSN/AP, 9 Oct). O'Connell promised a determination on Saturday; by 09:30 Eastern none was public, and TSN's report has it decided on Sunday morning. If Minnesota elevate Odell Beckham Jr. today, read it as doubt and no more: with both receivers cleared he would just be inactive.

case.label: The order
case.body: Addison, 11.4, is the tool's fallback and plays in the same game, but he is questionable too (hamstring, limited Thursday and Friday). If both are inactive, McLaurin, 12.8, takes the receiver slot if he is active and Gordon stays in the flex. All of them kick off at 11:00, so one look at 09:30 settles it.

case.label: If all three sit
case.body: Then you have no healthy receiver for the slot and the free add is Romeo Doubs, 12.2, for Monangai, who is out and in a walking boot. New England play at 11:00 too. Doubs is one of four New England receivers sharing Hollins's work, not a lead receiver, so this is a last resort. It takes three inactives to get there; it is written down so you are not working it out at 09:35.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jefferson is active and Addison outscores him on Sunday (archive). If Jefferson is inactive this card fires and the open lineup thesis closes untested.

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai is out, in a boot, with no return date
whatWentWrong.lead: Turf toe, a boot and a specialist. Nothing new overnight, and nothing that sounds like one week.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Ruled out on Friday without a practice all week. Ben Johnson: 'He won't be participating in this game, and we'll see how long that injury sidelines him', and 'We got him with a specialist' (Shaw Local, 9 Oct). In a boot and 'week-to-week'; NFL.com calls it turf toe. D'Andre Swift was full and has no designation.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: No lineup move: he was on your bench and ESPN projects 0.0. It makes his the seat that opens first, which is why the second card's last resort names him as the drop.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A return to practice next week keeps him. A move to injured reserve or a second missed game makes him the drop for Tuesday's claims, when you also need a defence for Minnesota's bye.

whatWentWrong.title: Both Vikings receivers are still questionable, and no decision has been published
whatWentWrong.lead: The Saturday call had not come by 09:30 Eastern and may now be a Sunday-morning one. Your fallback for one is the other.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Jefferson limited three days, Addison two; both questionable (vikings.com). O'Connell said on Friday he would decide on Saturday; TSN/AP has the status 'decided Sunday morning'. No elevation of Odell Beckham Jr. had been posted. Their left tackle is out, their right tackle and centre are questionable, and their left guard is out for the season.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second card's order: Addison first, McLaurin second. It is also why McLaurin's own status matters twice.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A report this afternoon that either will play, or a downgrade to out. Either way the swap is made from the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday, after tomorrow's brief.

worthALook.name: Romeo Doubs
worthALook.lead: Free, with Hollins ruled out. A correction: he is one of four receivers sharing that work, not the lead. The seat he would take is Monangai's.

case.label: The role
case.body: Mack Hollins (calf) did not practise all week and is out (patriots.com, 9 Oct 14:37). In the game Hollins left, Doubs drew 9 targets and scored twice, 23.8 (archive); targets 3, 4, 4, 9. But New England's own analysis names a four-man group, Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Kyle Williams and Efton Chism III, and says it was Chism who took Hollins's outside role and caught the winning touchdown (patriots.com, 9 Oct 14:40). Friday's brief called Doubs the lead receiver; nothing the team published says so. Las Vegas arrive to face a secondary missing four corners, which points to a game with passing in it.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 12.2, behind McLaurin's 12.8 and only 1.3 above Gordon, so he does not clearly start this week. A.J. Brown is eligible to come off injured reserve for Week 6, and nobody at New England has said whether he will. A role that may last one more game is not worth an 80%-rostered back.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Monangai going on injured reserve or missing a second week, which opens the seat; or Jefferson, Addison and McLaurin all inactive on Sunday, which makes him a starter that morning. He is a free agent, so waiting costs no priority, only the risk a rival adds him.
